title: Good Night, Kimi!

intro.title: Last Time...
intro.sub:
Kimi was brave at the doctor's, and found a wiggly tooth!
Tonight it sits under her pillow... but first, the evening routine!

scenes.title: Homework First!
scenes.caption:
Before any fun, one little mission:
the homework notebook!

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: Do you have any homework? Show me your assignment notebook.

lines.speaker: kimi
lines.text: Yes, I do... 😅

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: Play after you do your homework.

lines.speaker: kimi
lines.text: All done! I finished it! ✅

scenes.title: TV Time
scenes.caption:
Homework done = show time!
But not too close to the screen...

lines.speaker: kimi
lines.text: Mom, come here! It's my favorite show. It's going to start!

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: Back off a little. Your eyes will get bad.

lines.speaker: kimi
lines.text: Wow, it's really fun! 😂

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: Sit straight while watching.

scenes.title: The Potty Dash
scenes.caption:
Uh oh... too much juice at dinner!
Quick, quick, quick!

lines.speaker: kimi
lines.text: Mom, I have to pee! I can't hold it! 🚽

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: Hold it! Hold it! ...Okay, go, go, go!

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: Don't forget to flush.

lines.speaker: kimi
lines.text: Flushed! And I washed my hands, too! 🙌

scenes.title: Bubble Bath Time
scenes.caption:
Warm water, mountains of foam,
and a bubble beard contest!

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: It's time to take a bath. Want to wash your hair first?

lines.speaker: kimi
lines.text: Yes! My head is itchy!

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: Let's make some foam with the shampoo. Now give yourself a final rinse.

lines.speaker: kimi
lines.text: Look, Mom — a bubble beard! 🫧

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: Your hair smells so good now. Let's dry it with the blow dryer.

scenes.title: Ponytail or Pigtails?
scenes.caption:
Tomorrow is a big day.
Time for the prettiest hair in the world.

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: Let's comb your hair. Do you want a ponytail or pigtails?

lines.speaker: kimi
lines.text: Pigtails, please! Two of them!

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: Don't move. ...Your hair has grown a lot!

lines.speaker: kimi
lines.text: Ta-da! So pretty! 🎀

scenes.title: One More Story
scenes.caption:
Blanket: tucked. Pillow: fluffed.
Tooth under pillow: ready. ✨

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: Choose a book you want to read.

lines.speaker: kimi
lines.text: This one! Will you read until I fall asleep?

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: Mommy will read to you until you fall asleep.

lines.speaker: kimi
lines.text: Mom... will the tooth fairy really come tonight? 🦷

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: Yes, sweetie. Close your eyes... Good night, Kimi. 🌙

songs: 🔁 Replay all your favorites from Episodes 1-8!

ending.title: The End... Sweet Dreams, Kimi!
ending.sub:
That's the whole day with Kimi — all 8 episodes! 🎉
Replay any episode anytime. Good night! 🌙
